body:
This pull request looks good overall. Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files.

<details>
<summary>Suppressed comments (2)</summary>

* **src/services/authService.ts:2** — `isTokenExpired` compares `expiresAt` (a Unix seconds timestamp) against `Date.now()` (milliseconds), so tokens are treated as expired roughly 1000x too early.
* **src/services/authService.ts:10** — `refreshToken` does not clear the old refresh token from `tokenStore` before storing the new one, potentially leaking a stale valid token.

</details>
